facts.fact: ANP reports that on 8 July 2026 the health minister opened the workshop validating the costed roadmap of the Schéma Directeur National de la e-Santé 2025-2029, 27 projects covering hospitals among other fields, at which OpenClinic, the hospital information system and computerised patient record project, was presented as already under way.

At the 8 July 2026 roadmap validation workshop the Directorate of e-Santé presented the OpenClinic project, for a hospital information system and computerised patient record, as one of several projects already engaged; ANP gives no sites or counts.
